# netbox_virtual_circuit (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox virtual circuit (`/api/circuits/virtual-circuits/`) by `id` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_circuit" "pw9001" {
  filters = [
    { name = "cid", value = "LUM-L2VPN-9001" },
  ]
}

output "pw9001_status" {
  value = data.netbox_virtual_circuit.pw9001.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/circuits/virtual-circuits/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.

### Read-Only

- `cid` (String) Unique circuit ID.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `provider_account_id` (Number) ID of the Provider Account (`netbox_provider_account`).
- `provider_network_id` (Number) ID of the Provider Network (`netbox_provider_network`).
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `planned`, `provisioning`, `active`, `offline`, `deprovisioning`, `decommissioned`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to an empty set.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `type_id` (Number) ID of the Virtual Circuit Type (`netbox_virtual_circuit_type`).
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
